args.sql:
SELECT 
    ed.department_name AS department,
    env.lastname,
    lpr.rate,
    ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w::numeric, 4) AS cumulative_distribution,
    ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w::numeric, 4) AS percent_rank
FROM humanresources.employeenameview env
INNER JOIN humanresources.employee e ON env.businessentityid = e.businessentityid
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT businessentityid, rate
    FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory
    WHERE (businessentityid, ratechangedate) IN (
        SELECT businessentityid, MAX(ratechangedate)
        FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory
        GROUP BY businessentityid
    )
) lpr ON env.businessentityid = lpr.businessentityid
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT edh.businessentityid, d.name AS department_name
    FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
    INNER JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
    WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL
) ed ON env.businessentityid = ed.businessentityid
WHERE ed.department_name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ed.department_name ORDER BY lpr.rate DESC)
ORDER BY ed.department_name ASC, lpr.rate DESC;

arguments.question: calculate the salary percentile for each employee within the 'Information Services' and 'Document Control' departments
